notes.title: New Item "Map"!
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.9[/b]

[u]The [b]Map[/b] item was created to help players find the key that is hidden in the level.[/u]

[previewyoutube=r4Fihw11U9I;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*] 1 map have been added at levels 5 to 25
[*] 2 maps have been added at levels 26 to 50
[*] 3 maps have been added at levels 51 to 75
[*] 4 maps have been added at levels 76 to 100
[/list]

[i]Obs: On hard levels, the map will not appear.[/i]

notes.title: Speed Power Up!
notes.content:
[u]Version 1.7[/u]

[previewyoutube=T7kwou5wjtY;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]The Speed Power Up significantly increases player speed for 5 seconds.[/b]

[list]
[*] Levels 1 to 25 contain 1 speed power up.
[*] Levels 26 to 50 contain 2 speed power up.
[*] Levels 51 to 75 contain 3 speed power up.
[*] Levels 76 to 100 contain 4 speed power up.
[/list]

[i]Obs: The update was anticipated with 1 power only, as it was found a bug that lowered the player's level.[/i]

[b]Hope you like it ^^[/b]

notes.title: Difficulty Hotfix
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.6:[/b]

[u]Increased difficulty of levels:[/u]

2
3 - Relocated door, decreased time.
4 - Relocated hero, decreased time.
5 - Relocated door and key.
6 - Relocated key.
10 - Relocated key and door.
11 - Relocated hero and decreased time.
12 - Relocated hero.
13 - Relocated door and key.
15 - Relocated door and hero.
16 - Relocated hero.
17 - Relocated door and key.
19 - Relocated door, hero and decreased time.
22 - Relocated hero and decreased time.
23 - Relocated door, hero and decreased time.
24 - Relocated hero and decreased time.

And

All levels have [b]double spikes[/b] now.

[i]All Hard Levels gained a little more time because we now have more spikes.[/i]

[u][b]All levels have been re-analyzed and improved.[/b][/u]

notes.title: Gems!
notes.content:
[u]4 Hidden Gems have been added in the game.[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41452154/99a05251ad04fa88f93dbb2a86eb9e785f963e3f.png[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Red Gem
[*] Blue Gem
[*] Green Gem
[*] Purple Gem[/b]
[/list]

[i]Obs: It is not necessary to finish the level after collecting the gem.[/i]

notes.title: Version 1.4
notes.content:
[b]Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Better Pixel Arts
[*] Press Esc to Reset the timer.
[/list]

The Pixel Arts are now more beautiful and refined.
Now you can press [u]Esc[/u] to reset the timer if you think you don't have enough time to finish the level.

notes.title: Launch Update - More 25 Levels !
notes.content:
[u][b]Launch Update[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] More 25 Levels
[*] New Purple Tileset
[*] Stairs (Teleport)
[*] Metal Box
[*] Final Story Text
[/list]

In these 25 phases implemented the difficulty increased a lot, the maze was much bigger, the boxes heavier and a new teleport mechanic was implemented with the use of the stairs.
